acceptedAnswer.text: Employee advocacy involves employees sharing content on LinkedIn and other social networks. Instead of relying only on your company page or ads, your people amplify the message to their own networks, building trust and boosting reach.

DSMN8 provides your employees with a desktop dashboard and mobile app of ready-to-share content. Admins can pre-approve posts and let employees suggest content and add their own voice. With built-in scheduling, automation, and analytics, it's easy to launch and scale an advocacy program without adding extra workload.

mainEntity.name: What results can I expect from DSMN8?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clients see a significant lift in reach and engagement within weeks of launching. Employee-shared posts consistently outperform branded content. DSMN8 customers report increased website traffic, social media reach and engagement, increased applicants for roles, and higher quality leads — all while reducing reliance on ads.

Security is a top priority. DSMN8 supports enterprise-grade security including Single Sign-On (SSO), ISO-27001 certification, and strict data protection standards. You can be confident that your brand and employee data are safe.

mainEntity.name: What tools does DSMN8 integrate with?

acceptedAnswer.text: DSMN8 connects with tools like Slack, Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Adobe Analytics, and more. This makes it easy to keep advocacy aligned with your marketing and sales stack, while making adoption smooth for employees.

mainEntity.name: How do you measure success with DSMN8?

acceptedAnswer.text: DSMN8's analytics suite shows you exactly what's working: shares, clicks, engagement, earned media value, and more. You'll know which content drives results and how engaged your employee advocates are.

From onboarding to strategy guidance, training resources, and templates, DSMN8's customer success team is with you every step of the way. Whether you're new to advocacy or scaling globally, you'll always have expert support.

mainEntity.name: Does DSMN8 offer managed content curation services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. DSMN8 offers managed services for time-poor teams who need help curating and scheduling content. This is available as an add-on to the platform subscription. Learn more at dsmn8.com/employee-advocacy-managed-services/.
